title: Explainable NLP in the Era of Large Language Models: Survey Materials
description: Figures, figure-generation code, a machine-readable taxonomy, and the full bibliography for the survey 'Explainable NLP in the Era of Large Language Models: A Unified Taxonomy, Evaluation Frameworks, and Decision Guidance' (Hadi Mohammadi and Tina Shahedi, Utrecht University, under review at the Journal of Artificial Intelligence Research). An earlier and shorter version of the survey is archived at doi:10.5281/zenodo.18521290.
